question: What was the performance of multilingual BERT?

answer.free_form_answer: BERT had 76.6 F1 macro score on x-stance dataset.
evidence: To put the supervised score into context we list scores that variants of Bert have achieved on other stance detection datasets in Table TABREF46. It seems that the supervised part of x-stance has a similar difficulty as the SemEval-2016 BIBREF0 or MPCHI BIBREF22 datasets on which Bert has previously been evaluated.

title: X-Stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
answer_short: Baseline results from multilingual BERT show that zero-shot cross-lingual and cross-target transfer of stance detection is moderately successful with this approach.
answer_rationale: The performance of multilingual BERT is described in Text 6, which states that baseline results show zero-shot cross-lingual and cross-target transfer of stance detection is moderately successful with this approach. This is corroborated by other texts indicating M-Bert performs better than majority class baselines and shows capability for transfer, though with room for improvement.
